pages.title: Mine Hunt Classic
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Mine Hunt Classic asks you to uncover safe tiles without revealing a mine. Read the numbers to work out which neighboring squares are dangerous and mark suspected mines with flags. Choose a difficulty to change the board size and mine count.

pages.title: Bestie’s Y2K Butterfly Trends
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Bestie’s Y2K Butterfly Trends lets you style friends with fashion inspired by the early 2000s. Combine butterfly prints, cropped tops, skirts and accessories into new outfits, choosing the pieces that work together for each character's makeover.

pages.title: Offroad Crash Climber 4X4
pages.creator: Goolandia
pages.description: Offroad Crash Climber 4X4 sends a vehicle over rough terrain in endless runs and crash challenges. Balance it across steep hills, avoid hazards and collect coins. Improve the engine, suspension, wheels and fuel capacity to prepare for harder routes.

pages.title: Math Stars
pages.creator: Pavel Beke
pages.description: Math Stars turns addition and subtraction into a space expedition. Choose an unlocked planet and tap the crystal carrying the correct answer. Complete question sets to reach bosses, then solve further problems to continue exploring the galaxy.

pages.title: ASMR Makeover & Makeup Studio
pages.creator: Bravestars Games
pages.description: ASMR Makeover & Makeup Studio lets you care for a virtual model's skin before creating a makeup look. Choose skincare products, then experiment with eyeshadow, lipstick and other cosmetic options. Combine the selections into a finished makeover.

pages.title: Cool Cars: racing at altitude
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Cool Cars: racing at altitude combines track challenges with building a car collection. Gather bonuses on the main route, attempt timed special tracks and earn points for vehicles and workshop improvements. Develop your garage while taking the cars through further races.

pages.title: Geometry Flap
pages.creator: Breymantech
pages.description: Geometry Flap sends a changing arrow through a maze of geometric gates and traps. Tap to flap and guide its movement through the openings. A collision ends the attempt, so each narrow passage demands a carefully timed adjustment.

pages.title: Sudoku Master
pages.creator: in8finity
pages.description: Sudoku Master asks you to fill a nine-by-nine grid without repeating a number in any row, column or three-by-three box. Select empty cells and use the existing clues to determine their values, choosing a difficulty suited to the puzzle you want.

pages.title: Merge Galaxy
pages.creator: MOVISOFT.Co.,Ltd
pages.description: Merge Galaxy lets you launch planets into a play area where matching ones combine into larger worlds. Judge the effects of gravity as you aim, placing each planet where another merge can follow. Work through the growing sequence toward creating a sun.

pages.title: Gloves Grow Rush
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Gloves Grow Rush follows a stickman boxer collecting gloves on a running course. Fight weaker boxers and avoid opponents whose strength exceeds yours, building up for the final boss. Gather gems to improve the fighter between attempts.

pages.title: Steal Items io
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Steal Items io sends an unsteady stickman into houses to carry valuables back to a truck. Race competing stickmen to the more expensive objects, grab what you can and deliver each load. The aim is to collect the greatest value of stolen goods.

pages.title: Obby Halloween Danger Skate
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Obby Halloween Danger Skate takes a skateboarder across rooftops above toxic floodwater. Jump between barrels and containers, collect pumpkins and reach the finish without falling. Work through fifteen stages and use the shop to buy additional costumes.

pages.title: Fall Bean 2
pages.creator: Merlot Games
pages.description: Fall Bean 2 sends competitors through rounds of obstacle-course racing. Move, jump and roll past the hazards while trying to stay ahead of elimination. Survive the changing courses to reach the final and become the last player standing.

pages.title: Falling Man
pages.creator: TuuT
pages.description: Falling Man follows a thief dropping from great heights through obstacle-filled routes. Steer clear of hazards and gather coins during the fall, using magnets and gravity power-ups along the way. Spend collected coins on additional character skins.

pages.title: Daily Crossword
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Daily Crossword provides a fresh word grid to solve each day. Read the clues and enter their answers into the corresponding spaces, using the letters where words cross to help resolve the remaining entries and complete the daily puzzle.

pages.title: Posing Puzzle
pages.creator: Rocket Studio
pages.description: Posing Puzzle asks you to hide characters inside outlined shapes before a pursuer reaches them. Tap each person to change their pose and find the arrangement that fits. Several people may need coordinated positions within the limited time.

pages.title: Highschool Mean Girls 2
pages.creator: Gamerina
pages.description: Highschool Mean Girls 2 follows two groups of friends preparing for their first school day. Style their outfits from the available wardrobe choices, comparing different combinations as the groups compete to make an impression with their new looks.

pages.title: Mine Farmer 3D
pages.creator: onedoe
pages.description: Mine Farmer 3D turns preparing a field into a movement puzzle in a block-built world. Guide the farmer through the layout and get the entire field ready for planting, working out how to reach the remaining ground as each stage changes.

pages.title: Mahjong Dogs
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Mahjong Dogs uses dog pictures on a timed tile-matching board. Remove identical pairs that have an open left or right side, uncovering further choices as the layout shrinks. Use a hint if needed while trying to clear the arrangement before time expires.

pages.title: Stickman Hero Fight
pages.creator: BotaGame
pages.description: Stickman Hero Fight lets you choose a hero and battle villains with movement, attacks and defensive abilities. Jump, teleport, block or transform during encounters, then unlock stronger skills as you complete levels and develop the fighter's combat options.

pages.title: Fruits Memory
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Fruits Memory hides fruit pictures behind cards on a timed board. Turn over two cards and remember their positions to locate matching pairs. Clear every pair to finish the level, with later stages presenting harder arrangements to remember.

pages.title: Police Endless Car
pages.creator: Vitalitygames.com
pages.description: Police Endless Car puts you behind the wheel of a car escaping a police pursuit. Steer along the road, jump when needed and collect coins and power-ups. Keep the chase going while looking for a route past the next hazard.

pages.title: Rubber Band Slice
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Rubber Band Slice focuses on cutting elastic bands wrapped around objects. Use the mouse to slice through the layers and free the item beneath them, continuing through the different objects presented by the game's cutting activities.

pages.title: Jasmine Beauty Salon
pages.creator: FreezeNova.Games
pages.description: Jasmine Beauty Salon lets you give Jasmine a new appearance through several salon activities. Choose a hairstyle and hair color, then work on her nails and fashion selections. Combine the options into a coordinated makeover for the character.

pages.title: Fuse 3
pages.creator: Absolutist Ltd.
pages.description: Fuse 3 combines matching numbers with building larger values. Form groups of three or more identical digits to leave a doubled-value tile in their place. Making the match on a gray tile also doubles the score, changing which group is worth choosing next.

pages.title: Small Archer 2
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Small Archer 2 gives an archer a succession of targets with only one shot allowed at each. Line up the aim carefully and release an arrow, trying to satisfy the challenge's conditions so the character can avoid imprisonment.

pages.title: Winter Trucks Jigsaw
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Winter Trucks Jigsaw includes twelve winter-truck pictures that unlock in sequence. Complete the first available image to open the next one, choosing a difficulty and dragging the pieces into place to restore the whole scene.

pages.title: Stolen Museum: Agent xXx
pages.creator: Simplegame
pages.description: Stolen Museum: Agent xXx follows agents retrieving stolen paintings through rope-based escape puzzles. Guide their slide along the route while avoiding hazards, then recover the missing artwork. Gather painting fragments to work toward restoring the damaged pictures.

pages.title: Dumb Zombie Online
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Dumb Zombie Online turns limited-ammunition shooting into a physics puzzle. Aim at zombies and use the scene's physical interactions to eliminate every enemy on the screen. Completing levels earns money that can buy additional equipment for later challenges.

pages.title: Island Puzzle
pages.creator: AppyApp
pages.description: Island Puzzle follows a pilot and a cat named Tom surviving on an island. Solve matching puzzles as their adventure continues, restoring and decorating its different areas while uncovering the secrets hidden around their new surroundings.

pages.title: Change Square
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Change Square asks you to match a square's color to the ball about to touch it. Tap to cycle the square's appearance and watch the incoming ball. A different color at the moment of contact ends the attempt.

pages.title: Square Jet
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Square Jet equips a small square character with a jetpack for platforming stages. Move and jump through each layout, then hold the flight control to rise over dangerous obstacles. Later levels make the route harder to negotiate safely.

pages.title: Mega City Stunts
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Mega City Stunts mixes stunt driving with races against computer-controlled cars. Explore the city's challenges alone or join a second player, using nitro and the handbrake to handle the route while competing for a better finish.

pages.title: Merge Cafe
pages.creator: vetx
pages.description: Merge Cafe starts you running a tea house with cakes to combine and serve. Merge identical recipes to discover new bakery items, then drag the requested food to customers. Expand the menu as you develop the cafe's range of treats.

pages.title: Flippy Bottle
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Flippy Bottle challenges you to carry a bottle upward across platforms. Click or tap to make it jump and flip toward the next landing, timing each attempt so it reaches another surface instead of falling back down.

pages.title: Fruit Slot Machine
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Fruit Slot Machine recreates fruit-themed slots with virtual coins, selectable bets and paylines. Spin the reels to see which combinations appear, with wild symbols, free spins and a bonus game among the possible features. Check the paytable for the game's rewards.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter Candies
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Bubble Shooter Candies challenges you to remove every candy from a board. Fire pieces into groups of at least three matching candies to clear them, choosing useful angles through the remaining arrangement across the game's thirty-six levels.

pages.title: Superhero Violet Fashion Shoot
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Superhero Violet Fashion Shoot follows Violet preparing a photo shoot to reveal a new style. Choose fashionable looks inspired by anime and social-media trends, coordinating her appearance for the pictures she wants to share with friends and followers.

pages.title: Sports Bike Challenge
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Sports Bike Challenge sends a motorcycle over hills, gaps and dangerous obstacles. Balance the bike, jump when the route demands it and collect coins along the way. Five hundred coins let you continue after losing a life.

pages.title: US Police Prisoner Transport
pages.creator: gamefun
pages.description: US Police Prisoner Transport puts you in charge of a vehicle carrying prisoners through a security operation. Drive along the assigned route and handle the transport carefully, working through the movement challenges involved in bringing the vehicle to its destination.

pages.title: Collect Candy
pages.creator: NoticeGames.com
pages.description: Collect Candy is a timed sweet-collecting challenge. Use the mouse to gather as many candies as possible before the clock expires, working to improve the total collected during your next attempt at the round.

pages.title: Cement Trucks Hidden Objects
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Cement Trucks Hidden Objects hides ten items inside cement-truck pictures. Search the scene and select each concealed object within one minute to advance. Work through six levels, examining the truck and its surroundings for the remaining items.

pages.title: La Linea play
pages.creator: La Linea App
pages.description: La Linea sends a character across a sequence of platforming stages. Move through the layout, jump between surfaces and use the firing control when needed, working through the obstacles that stand between the character and the next part of the course.

pages.title: Billiard Golf
pages.creator: Hitgames.org
pages.description: Billiard Golf uses a pull-and-release shot to send a ball toward a hole. Drag back to choose the power and let go to strike, accounting for the layout's angles. Excessive force can carry the ball past its destination.

pages.title: Wild Birds Match 3
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Wild Birds Match 3 turns bird pictures into a row-matching puzzle. Arrange at least three identical tiles together to earn points and keep the side gauge from falling too far. Continue finding combinations to maintain the round and improve your score.

pages.title: Spooky Bubble Shooter
pages.creator: Online Games io
pages.description: Spooky Bubble Shooter asks you to rescue the Cherry Monster by clearing colored balls from the play area. Aim at matching groups and use available boosters to help remove them, working toward a better star rating for each completed challenge.

pages.title: Cake Mania
pages.creator: Fat Boy Studio
pages.description: Cake Mania fills its match-three board with cake pieces. Select two items to swap their positions and create matching combinations, using bombs to clear more of the field. Keep finding productive exchanges to build a higher score.

pages.title: Extreme Motorbikes Match 3
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Extreme Motorbikes Match 3 presents motorcycle tiles to arrange in rows of three or more. Make matching groups to score points while watching the side gauge. Keeping it from draining too low lets you continue searching for further combinations.

pages.title: Blast Red!
pages.creator: IriySoft
pages.description: Blast Red! challenges you to remove every red block without sending the green blocks into the water. Tap a red block to shoot it and rotate the island to inspect another angle, considering how the remaining stack will fall.

pages.title: Water Cave
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Water Cave lets you dig through sand to guide water toward burning plants. Draw a channel that carries the flow through the terrain and onto the fire, shaping the route around the scene so the water reaches its destination.

pages.title: Yeezy Sisters Fashion
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Yeezy Sisters Fashion puts you in charge of looks for an anniversary fashion show. Browse the sisters' clothing choices and assemble coordinated outfits for their appearance, working through the styling activity to prepare each participant for the event.

pages.title: Free Helicopter Flying Simulator
pages.creator: Best Free Games
pages.description: Free Helicopter Flying Simulator offers free flight and helicopter missions. Take off, adjust altitude and steer the aircraft through the environment, using turning and sideways controls to position it. Choose exploration or the assigned flight challenges as you play.

pages.title: Knock Down Cans
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Knock Down Cans gives you a limited supply of balls for toppling stacks of cans. Aim at a useful part of each arrangement to bring down the remaining targets, working toward a three-star result with well-placed throws.

pages.title: Airport Manager
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Airport Manager puts you through the tasks of looking after airline passengers. Cook and serve food during flights, attend to passenger requests and clean the cabin after landing. Complete the activities that keep the aircraft ready for its next trip.

pages.title: TopBurer
pages.creator: fugames
pages.description: TopBurer puts you behind a burger counter with timed customer orders. Select the requested ingredients and side dishes in the proper sequence to serve each customer. Complete the level's goals as additional ingredients and orders enter the cooking challenge.

pages.title: Calculame
pages.creator: Nicolas Tacgorian
pages.description: Calculame turns quick arithmetic into a race against the clock. Solve the displayed calculations and keep answering correctly as their difficulty increases. Manage your lives and use unlocked aids while trying to reach the harder stages and improve the score.

pages.title: Finger Soccer 2020
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Finger Soccer 2020 asks you to send the ball into the net by choosing a player and directing a move. Tap the desired footballer to make the play, judging the direction needed to bring the ball toward the opposing goal.

pages.title: The World's Easiest Quiz Game
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: The World's Easiest Quiz Game presents a sequence of question-based puzzles to solve. Examine each prompt and select the answer you think fits, working through the game's challenges one choice at a time to reach the remaining questions.

pages.title: Car Parts
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Car Parts hides automotive pictures behind tiles in a four-level memory challenge. Flip two tiles and remember their positions to find matching pairs. Clear the board while trying to finish each arrangement with fewer moves.

pages.title: Fruit Snake Challenge
pages.creator: KidsGames4All
pages.description: Fruit Snake Challenge follows a snake with a taste for fruit rather than prey. Guide it toward the food using the directional controls, finding a route through the play area so it can reach its next snack.

pages.title: Oddbods Soccer Challenge
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Oddbods Soccer Challenge asks you to kick a football into the goal while the Oddbods interfere. Aim each attempt around the characters and obstacles in the scene, working through the different arrangements to find a successful scoring shot.

pages.title: Darts
pages.creator: Gamebuilt.com
pages.description: Darts lets you aim and throw darts at a numbered board. Choose where to place each throw and work toward the score required by the current match, using accurate hits to make the available darts count.

pages.title: Matryoshka Rush
pages.creator: Age Simple Games
pages.description: Matryoshka Rush challenges you to create a growing set of Russian dolls at different sizes. Keep each new doll within the red size boundary, judging its dimensions carefully as you try to extend the set and improve your record.

pages.title: Racing Gta Cars
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Racing Gta Cars uses sports-car pictures for an untimed jigsaw challenge. Select an easy, medium or hard layout and fit the pieces together to rebuild the vehicle image, comparing their colors and edges as the scene takes shape.

pages.title: Dots Pong
pages.creator: T
pages.description: Dots Pong asks you to switch the black and white dots as a ball travels between them. Tap at the right moment to match the approaching color, keeping the exchange going as you try to extend the round.

pages.title: Archer Vs Archer
pages.creator: howardfrancisdavies
pages.description: Archer Vs Archer offers target combat across three archery modes. Try Running Archer or Mountain Archer on your own, or face a friend in a two-player duel. Adjust your shots to hit enemy archers as each mode changes the contest.

pages.title: Meowfia Evolution Endless
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Meowfia Evolution Endless combines rescuing kittens with building a cat collection. Open bags to find kittens and drag matching ones together to evolve them. Gather coins from cat poop and use fish to speed up production as the meowfia grows.

pages.title: Princess Mermaid Skin Doctor
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Princess Mermaid Skin Doctor follows a mermaid through a virtual skin-care appointment. Choose the game's medical tools to work on rashes, wounds and blemishes, completing the treatment activities that restore the character's appearance during her makeover.

pages.title: Matching Shapes
pages.creator: c2gamesstudio
pages.description: Matching Shapes puts two changeable shapes beneath incoming pieces. Adjust each one so it matches the corresponding shape descending from above. Correct matches earn points and extend the round, while failing to match an approaching piece ends the attempt.

pages.title: Red Carpet Stars
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Red Carpet Stars lets you prepare a princess for an event with her prince. Start with makeup and then choose clothing from her wardrobe, coordinating a finished outfit for the red-carpet gathering with other royal guests.

pages.title: Party Pop Match
pages.creator: Octeto Studios
pages.description: Party Pop Match turns groups of animal dancers into a party puzzle. Select the friends needed to meet the requested numbers and clear useful groups from the board. Choose timed or move-limited challenges while collecting additional dancer characters.

pages.title: Halloween Horror Massacre
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Halloween Horror Massacre turns tree chopping into a Halloween reflex challenge. Switch between the left and right sides of the trunk to keep striking it while avoiding branches overhead. Keep clearing sections to build the score without getting caught underneath a branch.

pages.title: Maze Runner 3D Cards Hunt 2018
pages.creator: Red Eye Production
pages.description: Maze Runner 3D Cards Hunt 2018 sends you through three-dimensional mazes to collect flash cards. Find every card within the time limit while avoiding obstacles, choosing among characters with different powers to tackle the six maze layouts.

pages.title: Fashion School
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Fashion School follows friends learning how to put together complete outfits. Take a course with Barbara, starting with a streetwear dress and progressing to a wedding look. Choose the clothing that suits each part of the fashion lesson.

pages.title: Mildly Infuriated Bird
pages.creator: Julio Cesar Fuente Saugar
pages.description: Mildly Infuriated Bird sends a bird through a course filled with pipes, spikes, traps and other threats. Flap to control its height and find safe gaps, gathering coins along the way as you try to improve the run's score.

pages.title: Beauties Pregnant Bffs
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Beauties Pregnant Bffs follows two expectant friends through a day of virtual care and styling. Complete the game's food and vitamin activities, choose decorative belly tattoos and dress each character in a different outfit to finish their shared routine.

pages.title: Dotted Girl New Year Makeup
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Dotted Girl New Year Makeup lets you prepare Dotted Girl for a New Year's party. Start with a spa activity, then choose eyelashes, eyeshadow and contour details. Finish the look with glittery face decorations for the celebration.

pages.title: Vloggers Life Tycoon
pages.creator: Princess Girls
pages.description: Vloggers Life Tycoon puts you through the process of making videos for a virtual channel. Record footage, edit it and publish the finished video, managing the creation sequence as you continue the character's work as a vlogger.

pages.title: Stickman Archery
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Stickman Archery gives an archer targets to hit with a bow. Set up each arrow's flight and judge the distance to the mark, adjusting the next attempt as you work through the game's target-shooting stages.

pages.title: Princesses Royal Ball!
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Princesses Royal Ball! lets you style Ellie, Annie and Ariel for the castle's annual ball. Choose dresses and coordinate accessories, flowers and other details, giving each princess a finished look for her appearance at the royal event.

pages.title: Jelly Escape
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Jelly Escape puts a jelly character into rooms lined with spikes and other obstacles. Use clicks to guide it toward the exit while collecting stars, timing the movement through the available gaps to complete each platform puzzle.

pages.title: Algerijns Patience
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Algerijns Patience uses two full decks for a solitaire challenge with opposing sequences. Build one set of foundations upward from ace to king and the other downward from king to ace, planning card moves to organize both sets by suit.

pages.title: Paws to Beauty: Back to the Wild
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Paws to Beauty: Back to the Wild lets you groom and style animal clients. Wash the selected pet with soap, rinse and dry its fur, then brush it. Finish the care routine by choosing clothing for the newly cleaned animal.

pages.title: Ellie and Annie Black Swan and White Swa
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Ellie and Annie Black Swan and White Swa prepares two sisters for contrasting ballet roles. Find the things they need, then design a black-swan look for one and a white-swan look for the other to complete their stage preparation.

pages.title: Angela and Tom Dream Wedding!
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Angela and Tom Dream Wedding! lets you design a wedding look for Talking Angela. Choose dress details and coordinate their style, experimenting with the available combinations to create the outfit she will wear for the couple's special day.

pages.title: Missiles Attack
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Missiles Attack challenges you to eliminate enemies with aimed missiles. Hold to line up the shot and release to fire through the level's obstacles, considering where the explosion will land. Work through the arrangements to clear the remaining targets.
